offer.text: My parent wishes to walk the old path one more time before their strength fails for good — but they shouldn't go alone. Guard them as they lead the way, and see them safely back to their bed. It would mean the world to us both.

accept.text: Walk slow, and let them set the pace. Let them have this.

decline.text: Please — they may not get another chance to ask.

in_progress.text: Are they alright out there? Keep close to them, won't you?

ready.text: Back home and resting easy? Then they had their walk after all.

complete.text: You gave my parent one last good day, and gave me peace to carry forever. There's no kindness greater than that. Thank you — from the bottom of my heart.
